Most people talking about "the dark web" are talking about TOR services. TOR (The Onion Router) is a system developed by the United States Navy (NRL) and DARPA.

TOR routes traffic through multiple endpoints with encryption. That makes it many orders of magnitude harder to track than the standard, mostly unencrypted web. That also means ... you can't access it from a standard web browser on a standard network connection.
